ashok: Quick q — planning a gradual rewrap for envelope keys across S3 blobs + DB rows. Are we doing auto-rotate (KMS rotate + background rewrap) or explicit manual rewrap runs? Concern: KMS quotas and RBAC scope for temporary rewrap workers.

olivia: leaning toward auto-rotate + background rewrap with throttled workers. Need clear fallback if KMS returns NotFound (key materially deleted) :thinking: 

maria: we need RBAC for the rewraper service account. For AWS: kms:Decrypt and kms:Encrypt (scoped to key ARNs). For GCP: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter. For Azure: Key Vault permissions `wrapKey`/`unwrapKey`. No broad admin perms.

kevin: Agree. Also add conditional restrictions on key ARN & region in policies. Don't give full account-wide perms. Also log every rewrap attempt to our audit stream with object id + key id (so we can trace).

ashok: Good — do we store envelope version header (e.g., v2) so new vs old keys detected? If so rewrapers can skip objects already on v2.

maria: yes header -> `envelope_version:2` in object metadata and DB column `envelope_version`. Rewrap worker flow:
```
fetch batch
if envelope_version == 2: skip
decrypt CEK with old KMS (using service account)
encrypt CEK with new KMS
write new CEK -> update metadata + increment version
emit audit event to audit-log topic
```

jen: What's our backoff for KMS throttling? We should cap QPS per key and per-region. Propose exponential backoff + jitter and a global token bucket in rewraper. Also start canary at 0.5% for first 24h then 5% then 25% then full.

sre-bot: Deploy completed: rewrap-worker v1.3 -> canary queue enabled (0.5%). See https://go.redwood.example/infra/rewrap-runbook for procedures.

olivia: Incident plan if rewrap fails at scale: 1) pause worker 2) snapshot failed object ids 3) fallback serve: allow runtime to decrypt using old CEK if policy `runtime.allow_decrypted_with_old_keys=true` is enabled 4) alert oncall + open incident.

kevin: Also add alert for >1% rewrap-failure-rate over 10m and KMS 5xx error spike. Audit log schema suggestion: `attempted_by`, `old_key_id`, `new_key_id`, `object_id`, `envelope_version_before`, `envelope_version_after`, `status`, `error_code`. Make fields searchable in ES.

ashok: OK. Action items: maria -> RBAC policy snippets for AWS/GCP/Azure; kevin -> runtime flag + fallback implementation; olivia -> update runbook & add our canary schedule + throttling knobs. I'll file a short RFC and ping security-review.

jen: +1. tagging @security-review for final sign-off.
